scope: Bybit-native 100ms top-five book cancellation and replenishment event flow used for directional taker entry. Residual displayed-size removal is separated from contemporaneous aggressive trade consumption. The screen tests opposite-side liquidity-pull plus same-side refill continuation and pull-then-refill failure reversal under executable latency, BBO crossing, cost stress and one global slot.
non_overlap: No passive maker order or queue-fill model; no two-sided hazard OCO; no generic tape-pace episode; no atomic matching-price sweep topology; no liquidation label, cross-venue propagation, round-number, session, quarter-hour, premium, curve, positioning or option state.
